narrative.headline: Plan Tokyo airport buses with exact terminals, dated fares and explicit travel-time uncertainty.
narrative.value_prop: Find routes and stops, inspect a JST service date, compare current duration evidence and plan party fares. Every result retains the provider source and observation time.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public read-only sources; no login, key or reservation action. Chrome-compatible HTTP runs without a resident browser.

quickstart.comment: Inspect the configured public source safely.
Read today in JST with exact airport terminals.
Observe duration estimates and unavailable states.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Airport Limousine public route/stop discovery, dated Tokyo airport-bus schedules, published fares and current duration evidence. Choose exact terminal IDs before interpreting times or party fares.
anti_triggers: Seat reservation, payments or account changes.
Arrival guarantees, flight-connection guarantees or seat-inventory claims.
Other bus operators or multimodal route pricing.
